policy: Unchanged inference, simplify, root-only display and temporal display; no thresholds tuned and no manual chord substitutions

validation.structural: Injection before transpose/Melody; source precedence, fingerprint guards, idempotence, unchanged notes and timed Full/Melody harmony equivalence

limitations: Generated accompaniment is heuristic and not an authoritative or human-approved arrangement.
Omitted ambiguous windows are not filled with invented chords; the preceding symbol is not proof of harmony through those gaps.
Six overlays retain musical-review flags; review the exact windows and close-spaced clusters below.
Hymn 307 Full-score beaming/spacing also appears in a no-overlay control; no engraving changes were made.
Playback remains driven by source notes rather than synthesized chord accompaniment.
